question: The Statement- "We shall die to awaken the nation" was made by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bagha Jatin, who was a revolutionary freedom fighter and a Bengali nationalist.**__

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• **The statement "We shall die to awaken the nation" signifies the determination and sacrifice of Bagha Jatin towards the freedom struggle of India.**
 
• Bagha Jatin was the founder of the Jugantar party, which aimed at overthrowing British rule in India.
 
• He was a brave and fearless leader who fought against the British in various revolutionary movements.
 
• He was eventually captured and executed by the British in 1915.
